content: I recall hearing about some work (perhaps by @Kim Morrison?) to make a one-click download of a fresh Lean+Mathlib+oleans install -- was there any progress on that? There will be ~80 people installing Lean at the Jerusalem workshop next week, and I wonder if I should try out a new install method, if it exists (rather than: download VS Code -> add Lean extension -> run lake exe cache get... For research mathematicians who don't know git, this is still difficult...) Thanks!
I think #general > trylean bundle for lean4 is the most recent movement on that. I haven't tried it personally.
Don't the steps at https://lean-lang.org/install/ make it easier?
It's not one click but three, but I think it saves you ever touching the command line
trylean is exactly what I was trying to remember, thanks! As for the install link, it's 3+1 clicks, where the fourth click says to open the Setup Guide :sad:
Oh I see, that's what happens when link number 3 doesn't open vscode? I think you get a better experience if you say "open vscode" on this dialog:
